audit.why: Both layers already read Riven / Riven / Riven / Riven / Gwen / Gwen / Skill, which is exactly what the mirror settled. The packet chart differs only at Level 3 (Skill), and the mirror wins that tie. No chart edits proposed, so nothing can desync.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hallowed Mist was described only as 'a long cooldown' with no number, and the two-item spike ended on 'your execute Window Slash'.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist is 22 seconds at rank 1 and only falls to 18 at rank 5 — the longest gap in Gwen's kit and the single timer that decides when Riven can commit. 'Window Slash' is not an ability; Riven's is Wind Slash.
audit.corrected: spikes[0] and whys[2] now carry the 22-second rank-1 number; spikes[3] fixed to Wind Slash and rebuilt around Snip Snip! and A Thousand Cuts by name.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry has Hallowed Mist backwards. wants.you[0] instructs the player to 'Place your combo OUTSIDE her Hallowed Mist so W-stun and Q autos connect', and wants.foe[0] says her plan is to make your abilities 'land outside the cloud'.
audit.why: Riot's text is unambiguous: the mist protects Gwen from enemies OUTSIDE of it, and she can only be targeted by enemies who ENTER the mist. Outside the cloud is precisely where nothing you do can touch her. A player following the current line stands off the mist waiting for a window that can never open, while Gwen farms freely inside it. The real counterplay is timing — kill her before she plants it, or step in and take the fight on that ground.
audit.corrected: wants.you[0] and wants.foe[0] rewritten to state the inside/outside rule the right way round; whys[2] no longer tells the player to land CC 'outside the cloud'.
sources: enemyKit W text 'protects her from enemies outside of it. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist'

notes: Following the mirror, I did NOT assert whether Wind Slash can reach a Gwen standing inside Hallowed Mist while Riven is outside it. The kit text settles targeting but not skillshot behaviour, and the 'mid' paragraph currently instructs the player to land Wind Slash 'BEFORE she gets the Mist repositioned', which assumes an answer — left untouched rather than confirmed or denied. The same inside/outside inversion appears in the 'early' paragraph ('never walk into the cloud and throw your combo at an untargetable target') and 'late'; both need the byte-exact pass, since full-layer and long-paragraph strings in this brief carry mojibake em dashes. Remaining 'he/him' references to Gwen live in mojibake-carrying strings (breakdown.trading, report[3].t, breakdown.feeding, dontsFull[0].d, report[8].t 'his healing', phases[6].why) — the three I could fix are fixed, and the rest should go in the same pass. The Executioner's Calling recommendation on this entry is legitimate: A Thousand Cuts is real healing.
